video_title: Jose Alvarado On NY Roots, Getting Into The NBA & Why He Still Has A Chip On His Shoulder

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the difficulty of making the NBA at his size
quotes.excerpt: You know how hard it is to make it to the NBA, especially in my size?
quotes.quote: I'm also ruining myself. You know how hard it is to make it to the NBA, especially in my size? I knew that was the X-factor of a lot of stuff, but I obviously put that behind me once I started getting my feet wet and putting myself in the rooms where people are making it to the NBA and I'm like, I could do this. This is something I could do.

quotes.speaker: DJ Envy
quotes.summary_phrase: DJ Envy and Jose Alvarado on his undrafted mindset
quotes.excerpt: When you were undrafted, did you know that I'm going to have to put in this extra work?

text_blocks.speaker: DJ Envy
text_blocks.text: On TV, you look way smaller than six-foot. When you were undrafted, did you know that I'm going to have to put in this extra work or did you think I was going to have to go overseas? What was the mindset then, because your whole life was basketball?

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: I didn't really have no second option. No plan B, I swear. But my junior year I had my daughter, so going into my senior year, I'm like, I need to figure something out. Money-wise, at least financially-wise. I was living with her parents and I was 22 years old asking my dad for money. So it was a lot going on. When I was getting my feet wet with this, I was like, I'm going undrafted, I was going overseas. Whoever is my agent, let's try to get this money overseas and build it up. And I was fine with that. I wasn't tripping.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on maintaining a chip on his shoulder
quotes.excerpt: I still got a chip on my shoulder because people don't understand like, I'm normal height.
quotes.quote: I still got a chip on my shoulder because people don't understand like, I'm normal height, I guess you could say, right? Or I don't know. I'm small in the NBA. I just knew every time I had to prove it. If you look down the line of my story, I never really had consistent minutes. I never really had consistent as a role. I always made it my way. Coaches always tell me, you're not going to play today or this is not going to go your way, but then the game needs some energy. They might have told me that before the game, but the game needed somebody to change it up and it was always me.

quotes.speaker: DJ Envy
quotes.summary_phrase: DJ Envy and Jose Alvarado on taking a pay cut to stay with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Would you take a short to stay with the Knicks, like Jalen Brunson did?

text_blocks.speaker: DJ Envy
text_blocks.text: Would you take a short to stay with the Knicks, like Jalen Brunson did?

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: It got to make sense though. Jalen Brunson, he took a short, but he knew at the back end that he's going to get that back. So I'm not going to get no 100 million back, so I got to see what makes sense for everybody. I do truly feel like if it's a great opportunity to stay home, I stay home.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the Pelicans' series against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: We know he was going to be a problem, but we never had like, I ain't going to lie.
quotes.quote: We know he was going to be a problem, but we never had like, I ain't going to lie, we won because we was on that. We knew we was like, whatever happens, we going to make this work. And to be honest, I wasn't there at the time, so they picked them in the NBA Cup. When you know you could beat a team at another high level, like there was no fear. It was appropriate fear, like they good enough to beat us, but we know we could beat them.
